exchanges: saskatoon is so flat lmao
It really is. Is it different from where you grew up?
not rly, i grew up in Humboldt so its flat there too, just smaller
So the city part is the big change.
ya there are so many ppl. my roommate ayesha thinks its tiny tho
Everything is relative.
lol. ayesha cant eat gluten so the dining hall is a nightmare for her
That is hard in residence. Do they mark the safe options?
kinda but they mess it up a lot
Hopefully they get better as the term goes on.
i got a job at the campus coffee place!! barista life
Congratulations! That will keep you caffeinated.
lmao true. also made the womens rugby team
That is great, congratulations.
our captain mele is terrifying in the best way. shes Samoan and she leads this war cry before games
She sounds like a strong leader.
she says i have good hands lol
That is high praise from a captain.
my sister ana is at Carleton doing journalism, shes the one who got me into rugby
Sounds like she has been a good influence.
and my stepsister bianca just started at Lakehead, were both first years together
That is nice, going through it at the same time.
ya we facetime and complain lol
Complaining together helps.
got hit hard at practice and the trainer thinks its a concussion
Ouch. Make sure you rest and follow what the trainer says.
i have to see the sports doctor on Thursday to get cleared
Good, getting properly checked is important.
ugh i hate missing practice
It is frustrating, but your brain comes first.
my lab partner hyun-woo is so chill, he rides a longboard to campus every day even in the rain
Brave in the rain.
he almost wiped out in front of the library today
Hopefully he wears a helmet.
oh wait i got mele wrong, shes Tongan not samoan, she corrected me at the team meeting lol
Easy mistake, glad she set it straight.
i felt so dumb
She probably did not mind, it happens.
anyway the headaches are mostly gone
That is a good sign.
im bored tho, cant study cant play
Maybe a podcast or audiobook would be easy on your head.
our res advisor marguerite came by to check on me, she speaks Michif with her grandma and was teaching me some words
That is a kind visit, and a nice thing to learn.
she brought me tea too
Very thoughtful of her.
wait which school is my stepsister at again

earlier_question.right_reply: Your stepsister Bianca is at Lakehead.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your stepsister Bianca is at Carleton.

what day is my appointment to get checked
what high school did ayesha go to
